3 out of 4 checks failed: fixed price not set, project leader not assigned, partial invoice not created
Only 1 check passed (likely project lookup or basic entity check), scoring 0.5 normalized due to auth failure
what_worked: One check passed, suggesting partial task completion or basic entity identification succeeded
Task was correctly parsed and initialized before the auth error occurred
what_to_try_next: Ensure the Bearer token is properly configured and non-empty before agent execution; validate auth credentials at startup
Implement a pre-flight auth check that verifies the token is valid before proceeding with any API calls
After fixing auth, set project fixed price (363850 kr), assign Ingrid Moe as project leader, then create a 75% partial invoice (272887.50 kr)
